race.comment: PASTORAL KING (5) made a highly professional debut at this venue, winning a Mdn by two lengths on heavy ground after being sent out favourite. He has already shown he handles the Bool conditions if they stay soft and he looks the horse with the upside to remain unbeaten. KING WEST (3) is the established form threat after placings at his past two, including a head defeat at this track when well-supported favourite and he maps for a sweet run. ICY POLE (7) was only beaten two and a half lengths first-up at this venue and has the right profile to improve second-up, though KING WEST did have her measure in that recent meeting. Chance with improvement. SECRET CROSSING (11) bolted in with an Avoca maiden at the third time of asking and warrants respect as well.
